requirements.text: Synchronous reset empties the FIFO: count 0, empty 1, dout 0, overflow and underflow 0.
Data is read out in the order it was written, including across pointer wraparound.
full is 1 exactly when DEPTH entries are stored; empty is 1 exactly when none are.
A write when full with no read is ignored and pulses overflow for one cycle.
A read when empty is ignored, pulses underflow for one cycle, and dout holds its value.
Read and write in the same cycle when full: the oldest word is read, the new word is stored, count stays DEPTH.
Read and write in the same cycle when empty: the word is stored, the read is ignored, underflow pulses.
almost_full is 1 exactly when count >= AF_THRESH.
count equals the number of stored entries after every cycle.
